{{BLP one source|date=May 2026}}
'''Michael P. Doyle''' was a professor of chemistry at [[University of Texas at San Antonio]]. Doyle was awarded the [[George C. Pimentel Award in Chemical Education]] by the [[American Chemical Society]] in 2002.<ref>{{cite web |url= https://www.eurekalert.org/news-releases/844648 |title= Tucson chemist wins national award for work with students |author= American Chemical Society |date= April 4, 2022 }}</ref> and elected as a [[Fellow of the American Association for the Advancement of Science]] in 1995.<!-- listed in their online directory, which does not allow deep-linking to the entry --> Doyle died on April 10, 2026.<ref>https://chem.umd.edu/news/memoriam-michael-p-doyle-1942-2026</ref>
